# TemporalComplexity

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The measure of how the computational difficulty of a task evolves over time, capturing the dynamic and time-varying nature of information processing in recurrent networks. Guides the design of neuromorphic systems that must handle time-dependent inputs and adapt to changing environmental states.
